text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"—Ouch! 
...Geez, why is it so dark inside this 
ship?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, Beauty's auditions always make us do 
weird stuff... 
Maybe this is just part of it?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm scared, Big Sis~. 
How far down do we have to go?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's all right, Vivlos. 
If you're scared, just hold my hand 
tight... Ah—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...Where are we?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『Bonjour, my lovely little rough 
diamonds! 
It's Beauty Anshinzawa speaking~~♪』"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Has everyone arrived at their starting 
positions? 
Today, in this spe~cially ma~de 
labyrinth—"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『You will be challenging the "Labyrinth 
Escape Audition"!♪』"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『This labyrinth has a 3-tier structure. 
Starting from the bottom floor, you must 
take the stairs to reach the top! 
The paths form a complicated maze, so 
watch your step♪』"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『Also, there are checkpoints located 
right before each set of stairs. 
You must clear the assigned task before 
moving forward!』"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『This screening requires you to pass all 
3 checkpoints 
and clear the labyrinth within the time 
limit!』"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『To the rough diamond who makes my heart 
go *kyupiiin* during the process, 
I shall gift a brilliant racing outfit! 
Well, sounds simple, doesn't it?』"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me, question! 
What exactly are the tasks at the 
checkpoints~?"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"『Oh, aren't you an eager one? But the 
fun part is—』"

"—Yeah, yeah. That's enough explanation 
already."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"We'll find out as soon as we try! Here I 
go!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Yaaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
"『Wait, she can do that?! We gotta go 
too!』 
『You're right! We can't let her beat 
us!』"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—It has begun! 
Let us go as well, Vivlos!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Okay! Let's do our best, Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"And so, the 'Labyrinth Escape Audition' 
has begun! All the candidates 
are dashing off all at once—wait, there is 
still one pair left at the starting 
line?!"

text_block_list.name: BDC Fan Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Is that King's team?! What are they 
dawdling for— 
Didn't she want to show a racewear outfit 
to her mother?!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, first things first: a strategy 
meeting, Sky-san!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Well, you're the leader, King, so 
it's fine by me, but... aren't we falling 
behind?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I happen to have a partner who hates 
rushing in without a plan. 
—I take it you have some sort of strategy 
for tackling this maze?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, placing so much trust in Sei-chan 
makes her blush! ♡

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, the classic way to not get lost is 
to leave markers along the path you take, 
right? Not that we can use it this time, 
though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why not? It's simple and sounds like a 
great idea!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Because this is an audition, remember? We 
can't go giving the other participants an 
advantage. We need to think of ways to 
outsmart them—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, but isn't that precisely why it's 
perfect? ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Lending a helping hand to others and 
winning regardless!! 
Now THAT is an attitude truly worthy of 
the name King!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, looking pretty confident, aren't we? 
And here I thought you'd be much more 
obsessed with winning.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't be silly. That is precisely why it's 
an audition.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate competitor obsesses over 
winning—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—while someone of the HIGHEST caliber 
obsesses over HOW they win!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—And so, just as Sky suggested, let us 
navigate this maze while leaving markers 
along the way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I shall show everyone a victory in true 
King fashion!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The highest caliber way of winning, huh? 
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, another dead end!! 
We're not making any progress at all!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Who even came up with this stupid maze?! 
It's so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
This path is more complicated than I 
expected— Next is... this way?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, Big Sis! 
If you go that way, you'll be 
backtracking!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Whoops. Thank you, Vivlos. 
How troublesome, I lose my sense of 
direction so easily—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then leave it to me, Big Sis! I'm great 
with unfamiliar paths! 
I love exploring new streets and towns 
too—so, here, this way, this way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That way's a dead end—and there! 
Not bad at all, feels like we've made 
quite a bit of progress!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Looks like King's markers are proving 
useful too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I saw this mark earlier!" 
"Yay, let's head this way then!"
Aaaaaahhhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, why are you guys already here?! 
I thought I left you way behind!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! 
For someone of my supreme caliber, this 
much is a walk in the park!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Muuuugh...!! It's easy-peasy for me too, 
you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's no waaaay I'm losing to you! 
Blllleeeehhh!!!!
